license_interpretation: The two licenses are not interchangeable. The Small checkpoint is Apache-2.0, a permissive license: it can be used in commercial and closed-source products, it asks you to keep its license text and attribution notices with any redistributed copy, and it grants a patent license. The Base and Large checkpoints are CC-BY-NC-4.0, which forbids commercial use outright and requires attribution on any redistribution, so treat them as research and evaluation weights unless you obtain separate terms from the authors. LibreYOLO's own code for this family is MIT throughout, and training is not offered for this family so there is no self-trained-weights exception to reach for.
bibtex_verified: 2026-08-08, copied verbatim from the Citation section of the upstream README on branch main (the README also lists a separate Depth Anything V1 CVPR 2024 entry, omitted here since LibreYOLO ports only V2). Cross-checked against the arXiv API for 2406.09414: seven authors in the same order, identical title, published 2024-06-13. The authors' own block still gives it as @article with the arXiv id as the venue, though the paper is widely reported as accepted to NeurIPS 2024; the README has not been updated to an @inproceedings form, so this entry is copied as published rather than reclassified. Do not hand-edit; a wrong citation misattributes someone's work.
